name: campus-sphere-root
description: CampusSphere — Unified Digital Ecosystem for Higher Education

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist/auth/callback', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/auth/callback/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html');"
